Exhaustive calculations independently verify all 73 and 14043 smooth marked pairs and ranks.

value.rationale: The D8 two-dimensional Ciani subfamily is a natural elliptic-quotient locus. Its exact eight-component nonordinary divisor with double branches and 25 transverse superspecial points gives nontrivial geometric structure and controls precise prime/quadratic field rank frequencies. The result is substantially more informative than an arbitrary low-parameter test or one superspecial example.
